$comment: ENGR app registry — every creator app on GOD and how ENGR can drive it. drivers: applescript | keycmd (System Events keystrokes, app must be frontmost) | mcu (Mackie Control over IAC MIDI bus) | shortcuts (`shortcuts run`) | cli | url | osc | files (watch/import folder). `scriptable` = has a real AppleScript dictionary.

Logic Pro.role: DAW — mix, edit, master NOIZYSTDZ sessions; LINA/GABRIEL/LUCY voice reels
Logic Pro.notes: No AppleScript dictionary beyond Standard Suite. Install Mackie Control on the ENGR MCU IAC bus (Control Surfaces → Setup → Install → Mackie Designs → Mackie Control). Key commands assume the US default preset; export yours to engr/logic/keycmds.json if customised.

Final Cut Pro.role: Video — demo edit, avatar renders + voice sync
Final Cut Pro.notes: FCPXML in/out is first-class; ENGR writes FCPXML for both Logic and FCP from the same session.

MainStage.role: Live character voice rigs (alternative FX host)

Audio Hijack.notes: AppleScript: `tell application "Audio Hijack" to start session named "Safety"` (AH4). Also exposes Shortcuts actions.

Loopback.notes: Loopback 2.3+: enable/disable devices and sources by name.

Talon.notes: ENGR writes .talon files into ~/.talon/user/engr/ so every ENGR action is a spoken command.

Stream Deck.notes: Buttons call `engr ...` via System: Open or a URL scheme.
